Hanta Sero (Sports Festival).name: Hanta Sero (Sports Festival)
Hanta Sero (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Hanta Sero, hero name Cellophane, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast his tape caught Katsuki Bakugo in midair and reeled him back to their cavalry team, which took second; in the tournament Shoto Todoroki answered his opening bind with a glacier that towered over the stands, and the crowd chanted "Don't mind" for him. Short black hair, a toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual jokes and easy nicknames, then short, plain field calls ("Grab on!").
Combat Role: Fast-starting capture and mobility support; the tape can be snapped, cut or frozen.
Under Pressure: Drops the jokes for the quick bind; laughs off a loss once it is over.
Hanta Sero (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wanted the national spotlight and got it: frozen in seconds while a stadium chanted sympathy; his real highlight helped someone else win. Motivation: Get noticed for something besides being the friendly guy. Concealment: Laughs about the ice and does not say how much the sympathy stung. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who rode his cavalry team, shouted orders and never said thanks; Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, his fellow horses under Katsuki; Shoto Todoroki, who froze him, muttered that he had gone too far and melted the ice with his left side; Sero holds no grudge. Knowledge: At the USJ attack he stayed by the entrance with Thirteen and helped Ochaco Uraraka drag the warp villain Kurogiri off balance so Tenya Iida could run for help; he heard the League of Villains say it came to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Hypes his friends; jokes about the ice before anyone can bring it up. Thread: Whether a plain Quirk gets its moment.
QUIRK: Tape from both elbows: strong and quick to fire, limited in reach and strength; it can be snapped, cut or frozen solid.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Cellophane; the country remembers the chant.
personality: Team glue: Makes himself useful to any team that needs mobility or a grab.
Opportunist: Strikes first and fast, betting one clean bind ends it.
Good loser: Laughs off his own loss and cheers the classmate who beat him.
Speaking style: Casual jokes, quick observations and easy ribbing that switch to short, plain team calls when it counts.
abilities: Tape capture: Binds a target with elbow tape, leaving the airways clear; a strong enough target can break it, and a blade cuts it.
Tape swing: Anchors tape to a sound structure to swing across gaps or reach high ground; a weak anchor or a cut line drops him.
Midair catch: Snags a flying or falling teammate with a line and reels them back; it needs a clear shot and firm footing.
Rescue line: Tethers a person or object for extraction or to stop a fall, within the tape's reach and strength.
Fighting style: Opens with an instant bind and drags the target off balance; if the tape is broken, cut or frozen, he has no second plan.
Hanta Sero (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A lanky young man with short, straight black hair, narrow dark eyes, a wide mouth and a big toothy grin, and light skin. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Relaxed, friendly expression, the grin a little lopsided.
